title: Putin asks for the full account
summary: Kiran Ilum Xenov tells of Putin asks for the full account, about After 1997 at Russia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: then he said, "Please tell me exactly how everything transpired, how it all unfolded."

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, described as a former president of one of Russia's republics who says he was taken by aliens in 1997, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that Vladimir Putin, Russia's leader, later asked him about it. Xenov says Putin told him, "Please tell me exactly how everything transpired, how it all unfolded." If true, it would mean the head of Russia took a personal interest in an alien abduction account.
